taskSchema.name: string — short human-readable name
taskSchema.type: string — from task-classifier.md (feature, bugfix, refactor, etc.)
taskSchema.owner: string — logical role or agent identifier
dependencies: array of task IDs that must complete first
verification: array of verification commands or evidence

phaseSchema.name: string — phase name
taskIds: array of task IDs in this phase

notes: Task state must reflect actual execution. Do not use this file as speculative documentation. Each tracked task should have a stable id and explicit dependencies. Update status transitions in real-time as work progresses.
